theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ with
  | refl a => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | par ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
    | red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ ha]
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩
    | red_S =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
  | red_I a =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | par hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ hc]
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  | red_K a b =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    | par ha hb =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
    | red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  | red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    | par hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S ..⟩
    | red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

  have h := h₁
  have k := h₂

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ <;> cases h₂
  all_goals first
    | exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩
    | exact ⟨_, by constructor <;> assumption, .refl _⟩
    | skip
  case red_I.par a c d hc ha =>
    rw [I_irreducible _ hc]
    exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par a b c d ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par a b c d e hd hc =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.red_I c a d ha iha hc ihc =>
    rw [I_irreducible _ hc]
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, ha⟩
  case par.red_K c b d hb ihb ha iha =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩
  case par.red_S d c e hc ihc a b hd ihd =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc)⟩
  case par.par a b c d ha hb iha ihb e f ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨x ⬝ y, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩

  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂

  case red_K.par a b c d ha hb =>

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => refine _root_.symm ?_
  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    obtain rfl := I_irreducible _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, ‹_›, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx ‹_›) (.par hy ‹_›), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.par iha ihb e f ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩
  all_goals repeat constructor <;> assumption

  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>

    apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption
  case par.par iha ihb e f ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩

  all_goals assumption

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par => apply _root_.symm
  case red_I.par | par.red_I =>
    obtain rfl := I_irreducible _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, ‹_›⟩
  case red_K.par | par.red_K =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩
  case red_S.par | par.red_S =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., by apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption⟩
  case par.par iha ihb e f ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩
  all_goals exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩

    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., by apply ParallelReduction.par <;> apply ParallelReduction.par <;> assumption⟩
